anchor.description: The day it counts from: a period's or a year's end, or a forecast's day.

due_on.description: Its due day; absent while not assessed.

extended.description: true when a one-off extension moved its day.

filing.description: The live record, once the item is recorded.

key.description: The item: its obligation and its anchor day. Record it with this key.

examples: The books start and the first financial year's end are not set: set them in Settings › Organisation

rolled.description: true when its day moved to the next working day.

source.description: The pack's sources of the rule, by id.

status.description: open; due_soon: within 14 days; overdue; filed or not_required: recorded; not_assessed: an input is missing, which reason names.

title.description: What is due, in plain words.
examples: Estimated chargeable income for the year ended 31 Dec 2026

why.description: The rule's words, from the sg-deadlines pack.
examples: Estimated chargeable income: within 3 months from the end of the financial year, unless waived (revenue of $5 million or below and ECI nil)
